formalization.definitions:
def IdxE (c : ℕ → ℕ) : Type := {x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ // 1 ≤ x.2.2 ∧ x.2.2 ≤ c x.2.1 ∧ x.1 < x.2.1}

inductive Gen (c : ℕ → ℕ) : Type
  | H1 : ℂˣ → Gen c
  | H2 : ℂˣ → Gen c
  | Xm : ℂ → Gen c
  | Ym : ℂ → Gen c
  | X : IdxE c → ℂ → Gen c
  | Y : IdxE c → ℂ → Gen c

noncomputable def cc (l j : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (-1 : ℂ) ^ (l + 1) * (Nat.choose (j - 1) l : ℂ) * ((l + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((j - l : ℕ) : ℂ)

def flipE {c : ℕ → ℕ} (e : IdxE c) : IdxE c :=
  ⟨(e.1.2.1 - 1 - e.1.1, e.1.2.1, e.1.2.2), ⟨e.2.1, e.2.2.1, by
    have h := e.2.2.2
    show e.1.2.1 - 1 - e.1.1 < e.1.2.1
    omega⟩⟩

section
variable {c : ℕ → ℕ}

def h1 (s : ℂˣ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := FreeGroup.of (Gen.H1 s)
def h2 (s : ℂˣ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := FreeGroup.of (Gen.H2 s)
def xm (u : ℂ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := FreeGroup.of (Gen.Xm u)
def ym (u : ℂ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := FreeGroup.of (Gen.Ym u)
def xx (e : IdxE c) (u : ℂ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := FreeGroup.of (Gen.X e u)
def yy (e : IdxE c) (u : ℂ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := FreeGroup.of (Gen.Y e u)

noncomputable def wm (s : ℂˣ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := xm (c := c) s * ym (-((s : ℂ)⁻¹)) * xm (c := c) s
noncomputable def wm1 : FreeGroup (Gen c) := wm (c := c) 1

noncomputable def ww (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) :=
  xx e s * yy e (-((s : ℂ)⁻¹) / cc e.1.1 e.1.2.1) * xx e s
noncomputable def ww1 (e : IdxE c) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := ww e 1

def comm' (a b : FreeGroup (Gen c)) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := a * b * a⁻¹ * b⁻¹
def eqr (a b : FreeGroup (Gen c)) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := a * b⁻¹
def conj' (a b : FreeGroup (Gen c)) : FreeGroup (Gen c) := a * b * a⁻¹
end

inductive GRel (c : ℕ → ℕ) : FreeGroup (Gen c) → Prop
  | H1a (s t : ℂˣ) : GRel c (eqr (h1 s * h1 t) (h1 (s * t)))
  | H1b (s t : ℂˣ) : GRel c (eqr (h2 s * h2 t) (h2 (s * t)))
  | H2 (s t : ℂˣ) : GRel c (eqr (h1 s * h2 t) (h2 t * h1 s))
  | Re1a (u v : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (xm u * xm v) (xm (u + v)))
  | Re1b (u v : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (ym u * ym v) (ym (u + v)))
  | Re2 (s t : ℂˣ) : GRel c (eqr (ym (-(t : ℂ)) * xm (s : ℂ) * ym (t : ℂ))
      (xm (-((t : ℂ)⁻¹)) * ym (-((t : ℂ) ^ 2 * s)) * xm ((t : ℂ)⁻¹)))
  | Re3 (s : ℂˣ) : GRel c (eqr (wm s * wm1) (h1 (-s) * h2 (-(s⁻¹))))
  | Re4a (u : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' wm1 (xm u)) (ym (-u)))
  | Re4b (u : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' wm1 (ym u)) (xm (-u)))
  | Re5a (s : ℂˣ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' wm1 (h1 s)) (h2 s))
  | Re5b (s : ℂˣ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' wm1 (h2 s)) (h1 s))
  | Re6a (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' (h1 s) (xm u)) (xm ((s : ℂ) * u)))
  | Re6b (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' (h2 s) (xm u)) (xm ((s : ℂ)⁻¹ * u)))
  | Re6c (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' (h1 s) (ym u)) (ym ((s : ℂ)⁻¹ * u)))
  | Re6d (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (conj' (h2 s) (ym u)) (ym ((s : ℂ) * u)))
  | Im1a (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (xx e u * xx e v) (xx e (u + v)))
  | Im1b (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) : GRel c (eqr (yy e u * yy e v) (yy e (u + v)))
  | Im2 (e : IdxE c) (s t : ℂˣ) :
      GRel c (eqr (yy e (-(t : ℂ)) * xx e (s : ℂ) * yy e (t : ℂ))
        (xx e (-((t : ℂ)⁻¹) / cc e.1.1 e.1.2.1) *
          yy e (-(cc e.1.1 e.1.2.1 * (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * (s : ℂ))) *
          xx e ((t : ℂ)⁻¹ / cc e.1.1 e.1.2.1)))
  | Im3 (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) :
      GRel c (eqr (ww (c := c) e (s ^ ((e.1.1 + 1) * (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1))) * ww1 e)
        (h1 ((-s) ^ (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1)) * h2 ((-s) ^ (e.1.1 + 1))))
  | Im4a (e : IdxE c) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (ww1 e) (xx e u)) (yy e (-u / cc e.1.1 e.1.2.1)))
  | Im4b (e : IdxE c) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (ww1 e) (yy e u)) (xx e (-(cc e.1.1 e.1.2.1) * u)))
  | Im5a (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (ww1 e) (h1 (s ^ (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1)))) (h2 ((s ^ (e.1.1 + 1))⁻¹)))
  | Im5b (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (ww1 e) (h2 (s ^ (e.1.1 + 1)))) (h1 ((s ^ (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1))⁻¹)))
  | Im6a (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (h1 s) (xx e u)) (xx e ((s : ℂ) ^ (e.1.1 + 1) * u)))
  | Im6b (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (h2 s) (xx e u)) (xx e ((s : ℂ) ^ (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1) * u)))
  | Im6c (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (h1 s) (yy e u)) (yy e (((s : ℂ) ^ (e.1.1 + 1))⁻¹ * u)))
  | Im6d (e : IdxE c) (s : ℂˣ) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' (h2 s) (yy e u)) (yy e (((s : ℂ) ^ (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1))⁻¹ * u)))
  | U1a (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) (h : e.1.1 + 1 = e.1.2.1) :
      GRel c (comm' (xm u) (xx e v))
  | U1b (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) (h : e.1.1 + 1 = e.1.2.1) :
      GRel c (comm' (ym u) (yy e v))
  | U1c (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) (h : e.1.1 = 0) :
      GRel c (comm' (ym u) (xx e v))
  | U1d (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) (h : e.1.1 = 0) :
      GRel c (comm' (xm u) (yy e v))
  | U2 (e f : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ)
      (h : e.1.2.1 ≠ f.1.2.1 ∨ e.1.2.2 ≠ f.1.2.2 ∨
        1 < |((e.1.1 : ℤ) - (f.1.1 : ℤ))|) :
      GRel c (comm' (xx e u) (yy f v))
  | U3a (e f : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ)
      (he : e.1.1 = 1 ∧ e.1.2.1 = 2) (hf : f.1.1 = 0 ∧ f.1.2.1 = 2)
      (hk : e.1.2.2 = f.1.2.2) :
      GRel c (eqr (comm' (xx e u) (yy f v)) (xm (u * v)))
  | U3b (e f : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ)
      (he : e.1.1 = 0 ∧ e.1.2.1 = 2) (hf : f.1.1 = 1 ∧ f.1.2.1 = 2)
      (hk : e.1.2.2 = f.1.2.2) :
      GRel c (eqr (comm' (xx e u) (yy f v)) (ym (u * v)))
  | U4a (e : IdxE c) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' wm1 (xx e u))
        (xx (flipE e) ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1 - 1) * u)))
  | U4b (e : IdxE c) (u : ℂ) :
      GRel c (eqr (conj' wm1 (yy e u))
        (yy (flipE e) ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (e.1.2.1 - e.1.1 - 1) * u)))

abbrev Gm (c : ℕ → ℕ) : Type := PresentedGroup {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r}
formalization.signature:
(c : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ((PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm (c := c) 0) : Gm c) = 1) ∧
    ((PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (ym (c := c) 0) : Gm c) = 1) ∧
    (∀ e : IdxE c,
      (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xx e 0) : Gm c) = 1) ∧
    (∀ e : IdxE c,
      (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e 0) : Gm c) = 1)
formalization.notes: Fixes: the relation type is renamed GRel (the name Rel clashed with the root `Rel`); the definitions that use complex inverses/division (cc, wm, wm1, ww, ww1) are marked noncomputable; Gm is now an abbrev for the PresentedGroup, so no separate Group instance is needed. The parameter c : ℕ → ℕ gives the index set E (IdxE c). Gen holds the generators H1, H2, X_{-1}, Y_{-1}, X_{ℓ,jk}, Y_{ℓ,jk}. GRel lists all relations (H, Re, Im, U families), and G(m) is the presented group. The statement asserts parts (a)–(d): X_{-1}(0), Y_{-1}(0), X_{ℓ,jk}(0) and Y_{ℓ,jk}(0) are trivial for every e ∈ E. No hypothesis on c is needed.
formalization.readback:
**Setting.** Fix an arbitrary function $c:\\mathbb N\\to\\mathbb N$. The statement is about the group $G_c$ defined below by generators and relations. It asserts four things about the images of certain generators in $G_c$.

**Index set.** Let $E_c$ be the set of triples $e=(a,b,k)\\in\\mathbb N^3$ with $a<b$ and $1\\le k\\le c(b)$. If $c(b)=0$ for all $b$, then $E_c=\\varnothing$. For $e=(a,b,k)$ write $c_e=\\mathrm{cc}(a,b)$, where
$$\\mathrm{cc}(l,j)=(-1)^{l+1}\\binom{j-1}{l}(l+1)(j-l),$$
using natural-number subtraction. Also set $\\bar e=(b-1-a,\\,b,\\,k)$, the "flip" of $e$, again using natural subtraction.

**Generators.** The generating set is the disjoint union of the following families, each a distinct formal symbol:

- $h_1(s)$ and $h_2(s)$ for $s\\in\\mathbb C^\\times$;
- $x(u)$ and $y(u)$ for $u\\in\\mathbb C$;
- $X_e(u)$ and $Y_e(u)$ for $e\\in E_c$ and $u\\in\\mathbb C$.

**The group $G_c$.** $G_c$ is the free group on these generators modulo the normal subgroup generated by the relators below. Each relator $r$ is imposed as $r=1$. The shorthands are:

- $[a,b]=aba^{-1}b^{-1}$, so a relator $[a,b]$ says $a$ and $b$ commute.
- ${}^{a}b=aba^{-1}$.
- A relator "$a=b$" means $ab^{-1}$.

Define the words
$$w(s)=x(s)\\,y(-s^{-1})\\,x(s),\\qquad w_1=w(1),$$
$$W_e(s)=X_e(s)\\,Y_e\\!\\left(-s^{-1}/c_e\\right)X_e(s),\\qquad W_{e,1}=W_e(1).$$
Here $s\\in\\mathbb C^\\times$ is viewed as a complex number in the arguments of $x$, $y$, $X_e$, $Y_e$. For $e=(a,b,k)$ the relations are the following.

- *Torus:*
  - $h_1(s)h_1(t)=h_1(st)$ and $h_2(s)h_2(t)=h_2(st)$.
  - $h_1(s)h_2(t)=h_2(t)h_1(s)$.
- *Additivity:*
  - $x(u)x(v)=x(u+v)$ and $y(u)y(v)=y(u+v)$.
  - $X_e(u)X_e(v)=X_e(u+v)$ and $Y_e(u)Y_e(v)=Y_e(u+v)$.
- *Re2:* $y(-t)\\,x(s)\\,y(t)=x(-t^{-1})\\,y(-t^2s)\\,x(t^{-1})$.
- *Im2:* $Y_e(-t)\\,X_e(s)\\,Y_e(t)=X_e(-t^{-1}/c_e)\\,Y_e(-c_e t^2 s)\\,X_e(t^{-1}/c_e)$.
- *Re3:* $w(s)\\,w_1=h_1(-s)\\,h_2(-s^{-1})$.
- *Im3:* $W_e\\!\\left(s^{(a+1)(b-a)}\\right)W_{e,1}=h_1\\!\\left((-s)^{b-a}\\right)h_2\\!\\left((-s)^{a+1}\\right)$.
- *Conjugation by $w_1$ (Re4, Re5):*
  - ${}^{w_1}x(u)=y(-u)$ and ${}^{w_1}y(u)=x(-u)$.
  - ${}^{w_1}h_1(s)=h_2(s)$ and ${}^{w_1}h_2(s)=h_1(s)$.
- *Conjugation by $W_{e,1}$ (Im4, Im5):*
  - ${}^{W_{e,1}}X_e(u)=Y_e(-u/c_e)$ and ${}^{W_{e,1}}Y_e(u)=X_e(-c_e u)$.
  - ${}^{W_{e,1}}h_1\\!\\left(s^{b-a}\\right)=h_2\\!\\left((s^{a+1})^{-1}\\right)$.
  - ${}^{W_{e,1}}h_2\\!\\left(s^{a+1}\\right)=h_1\\!\\left((s^{b-a})^{-1}\\right)$.
- *Torus action on $x,y$ (Re6):*
  - ${}^{h_1(s)}x(u)=x(su)$ and ${}^{h_2(s)}x(u)=x(s^{-1}u)$.
  - ${}^{h_1(s)}y(u)=y(s^{-1}u)$ and ${}^{h_2(s)}y(u)=y(su)$.
- *Torus action on $X_e,Y_e$ (Im6):*
  - ${}^{h_1(s)}X_e(u)=X_e(s^{a+1}u)$ and ${}^{h_2(s)}X_e(u)=X_e(s^{b-a}u)$.
  - ${}^{h_1(s)}Y_e(u)=Y_e(s^{-(a+1)}u)$ and ${}^{h_2(s)}Y_e(u)=Y_e(s^{-(b-a)}u)$.
- *Commutations U1* (for all $u,v\\in\\mathbb C$):
  - If $a+1=b$, then $[x(u),X_e(v)]=1$ and $[y(u),Y_e(v)]=1$.
  - If $a=0$, then $[y(u),X_e(v)]=1$ and $[x(u),Y_e(v)]=1$.
- *U2:* for $e=(a,b,k)$ and $f=(a',b',k')$ in $E_c$, $[X_e(u),Y_f(v)]=1$ whenever $b\\ne b'$, or $k\\ne k'$, or $|a-a'|>1$.
- *U3:*
  - If $e=(1,2,k)$ and $f=(0,2,k)$ (same $k$), then $[X_e(u),Y_f(v)]=x(uv)$.
  - If $e=(0,2,k)$ and $f=(1,2,k)$ (same $k$), then $[X_e(u),Y_f(v)]=y(uv)$.
- *U4:*
  - ${}^{w_1}X_e(u)=X_{\\bar e}\\!\\left((-1)^{b-a-1}u\\right)$.
  - ${}^{w_1}Y_e(u)=Y_{\\bar e}\\!\\left((-1)^{b-a-1}u\\right)$.

**The claim.** Let $\\pi:\\mathrm{Free}\\to G_c$ be the quotient map. The statement is the conjunction of four assertions:

1. $\\pi(x(0))=1$.
2. $\\pi(y(0))=1$.
3. For every $e\\in E_c$, $\\pi(X_e(0))=1$.
4. For every $e\\in E_c$, $\\pi(Y_e(0))=1$.

That is, the generators $x$, $y$, $X_e$, $Y_e$ with parameter $u=0\\in\\mathbb C$ are each trivial in $G_c$. This holds for every $c$ simultaneously. There are no further hypotheses on $c$. When $E_c$ is empty, assertions 3 and 4 are vacuous.
formalization.issues:
None. I compared the Lean definitions with the source and found no discrepancy.

- **Index set and generators:** `IdxE c` matches E: 1 ≤ k ≤ c(j) and ℓ < j. The generator families H1, H2 (over ℂˣ), Xm, Ym (over ℂ), and X, Y (over E and ℂ) match 𝒳.
- **Constants and words:** `cc` matches c_{ℓj}. The words w̃_{-1}(s) and w̃_{ℓ,jk}(s) match Re:0 and Im:0.
- **Relations:** Each relation in the source appears with the same arguments, exponents and side conditions. This covers H, Re1–Re6, Im1–Im6, U1a–U1d, U2, U3a/b and U4a/b.
  - The relator for "a = b" is a·b⁻¹, the commutator is aba⁻¹b⁻¹, and conjugation is aba⁻¹, all as in the source.
  - U1a/b correspond to ℓ + 1 = j and U1c/d to ℓ = 0.
  - U2's disjunction (j ≠ p, k ≠ q, or |ℓ − m| > 1) is reproduced.
  - U3 requires the same k and the indices (1,2) and (0,2).
  - The U4 flip index and sign exponent are right. Natural-number subtraction is harmless there because ℓ < j.
- **Group and claim:** `Gm c` is the presented group on these relators, which is F(𝒳) modulo the normal closure of ℛ. The theorem states exactly the four claims X_{-1}(0) = 1, Y_{-1}(0) = 1, X_{ℓ,jk}(0) = 1 and Y_{ℓ,jk}(0) = 1.
- **Parameter c:** Taking c : ℕ → ℕ as an arbitrary parameter is allowed by the formalization note. This lemma needs no hypothesis c(2) ≥ 1, so none is missing.

review.definitions_review:
I compared each definition with the source.
\begin{itemize}
\item \leanname{IdxE} encodes $E$ as triples $(\ell,j,k)$ of naturals with $1 \le k \le c(j)$ and $\ell < j$. Here $c:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ is a parameter, as the formalization note allows. The case $j=0$ gives no elements because $\ell<0$ is impossible, so the convention for $\mathbb{N}$ does not matter.
\item \leanname{Gen} encodes $\mathcal{X}$: $H_1,H_2$ on $\mathbb{C}^\times$, $X_{-1},Y_{-1}$ on $\mathbb{C}$, and $X_{\ell,jk},Y_{\ell,jk}$ on $E\times\mathbb{C}$.
\item \leanname{cc} is $(-1)^{\ell+1}\binom{j-1}{\ell}(\ell+1)(j-\ell)$. The truncated subtractions are harmless because $\ell<j$ on $E$. The value is nonzero on $E$, so the Lean convention for division by zero never arises.
\item \leanname{wm}, \leanname{wm1}, \leanname{ww} and \leanname{ww1} match (Re:0) and (Im:0).
\item The helper \leanname{comm'} is $aba^{-1}b^{-1}$, the source convention. The helper \leanname{eqr} encodes $a=b$ as $ab^{-1}$, and \leanname{conj'} is $aba^{-1}$.
\item \leanname{GRel}: I checked each constructor against its tag. The H, Re and Im relations agree, including the exponents in (Im:3), (Im:5) and (Im:6); for example $s^{-(\ell+1)}$ is written as $(s^{\ell+1})^{-1}$.
\item The U relations also agree.
  \begin{itemize}
  \item (U:1a,b) use $\ell+1=j$, and (U:1c,d) use $\ell=0$.
  \item (U:2) uses the disjunction $j\ne p$, $k\ne q$, or $|\ell-m|>1$.
  \item (U:3a,b) use the correct indices $(1,2,k)$ and $(0,2,k)$.
  \item (U:4a,b) use \leanname{flipE}, which sends $\ell$ to $j-1-\ell$, with sign $(-1)^{j-\ell-1}$.
  \end{itemize}
\item \leanname{Gm} is the presented group $F(\mathcal{X})/N_{\mathcal{R}}$.
\end{itemize}
I found no discrepancy.

sketch.main_proof:
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· exact add_zero_group_lemma
    (fun u : ℂ => (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm u : FreeGroup (Gen c)) : Gm c))
    (mk_xm_add c)
· exact add_zero_group_lemma
    (fun u : ℂ => (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (ym u : FreeGroup (Gen c)) : Gm c))
    (mk_ym_add c)
· intro e
  exact add_zero_group_lemma
    (fun u : ℂ => (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xx e u) : Gm c))
    (mk_xx_add c e)
· intro e
  exact add_zero_group_lemma
    (fun u : ℂ => (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e u) : Gm c))
    (mk_yy_add c e)

lemmas.name: add_zero_group_lemma
lemmas.statement:
theorem add_zero_group_lemma {G : Type*} [Group G] (f : ℂ → G)
    (h : ∀ u v : ℂ, f (u + v) = f u * f v) : f 0 = 1
lemmas.proof:
have h0 : f 0 = f 0 * f 0 := by
    calc
      f 0 = f (0 + 0) := by rw [zero_add]
      _ = f 0 * f 0 := h 0 0
  calc
    f 0 = f 0 * 1 := by simp
    _ = f 0 * (f 0 * (f 0)⁻¹) := by simp
    _ = (f 0 * f 0) * (f 0)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = f 0 * (f 0)⁻¹ := by rw [← h0]
    _ = 1 := by simp

lemmas.name: mk_xm_add
lemmas.statement:
theorem mk_xm_add (c : ℕ → ℕ) (u v : ℂ) :
    (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm (u + v) : FreeGroup (Gen c)) : Gm c) =
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm u : FreeGroup (Gen c)) *
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm v : FreeGroup (Gen c))
lemmas.proof:
have hrel := GRel.Re1a (c := c) u v
  have h2 : PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm u * xm v) *
      (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm (u + v)))⁻¹ = 1 :=
    PresentedGroup.one_of_mem hrel
  have h1 : PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm u * xm v) =
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm u) *
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xm v) := by
    simp
  rw [h1] at h2
  exact (eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one h2).symm

lemmas.name: mk_ym_add
lemmas.statement:
theorem mk_ym_add (c : ℕ → ℕ) (u v : ℂ) :
    (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (ym (u + v) : FreeGroup (Gen c)) : Gm c) =
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (ym u : FreeGroup (Gen c)) *
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (ym v : FreeGroup (Gen c))
lemmas.proof:
have hrel : GRel c (eqr (ym u * ym v) (ym (u + v))) := GRel.Re1b u v
  have h_eq : (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) =
             (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c) := by
    have h_one : (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (eqr (ym u * ym v) (ym (u + v))) : Gm c) = 1 :=
      PresentedGroup.one_of_mem hrel
    have h_mul_one : (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) *
                   ((PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c))⁻¹ = 1 := by
      calc
        (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) *
          ((PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c))⁻¹ =
          (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} ((ym u * ym v) * (ym (u + v))⁻¹) : Gm c) := by
          simp
        _ = (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (eqr (ym u * ym v) (ym (u + v))) : Gm c) := rfl
        _ = 1 := h_one
    calc
      (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) =
        ((PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) * 1) := by simp
      _ = ((PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) *
          (((PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c))⁻¹ *
           (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c))) := by simp
      _ = ((PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) *
           ((PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c))⁻¹) *
          (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 * (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c) := by rw [h_mul_one]
      _ = (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c) := by simp
  calc
    (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym (u + v)) : Gm c)
        = (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u * ym v) : Gm c) := by rw [← h_eq]
    _ = (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym u) : Gm c) *
        (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r} (ym v) : Gm c) :=
      (PresentedGroup.mk {r | GRel c r}).map_mul (ym u) (ym v)

lemmas.name: mk_xx_add
lemmas.statement:
theorem mk_xx_add (c : ℕ → ℕ) (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) :
    (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xx e (u + v)) : Gm c) =
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xx e u) *
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (xx e v)
lemmas.proof:
let rels : Set (FreeGroup (Gen c)) := {r | GRel c r}
  have h := GRel.Im1a e u v
  have hmem : (xx e u * xx e v) * (xx e (u + v))⁻¹ ∈ rels := h
  have h_eq : (PresentedGroup.mk rels) (xx e u * xx e v) = (PresentedGroup.mk rels) (xx e (u + v)) :=
    PresentedGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem hmem
  calc
    (PresentedGroup.mk rels) (xx e (u + v)) = (PresentedGroup.mk rels) (xx e u * xx e v) := by
      rw [h_eq]
    _ = (PresentedGroup.mk rels) (xx e u) * (PresentedGroup.mk rels) (xx e v) := by
      rw [(PresentedGroup.mk rels).map_mul]

lemmas.name: mk_yy_add
lemmas.statement:
theorem mk_yy_add (c : ℕ → ℕ) (e : IdxE c) (u v : ℂ) :
    (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e (u + v)) : Gm c) =
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e u) *
      PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e v)
lemmas.proof:
have h := GRel.Im1b e u v
  have h_eq : PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e u * yy e v) =
              PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e (u + v)) :=
    PresentedGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem h
  calc
    (PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e (u + v)) : Gm c)
        = PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e u * yy e v) := by
      rw [← h_eq]
    _ = PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e u) *
        PresentedGroup.mk {r : FreeGroup (Gen c) | GRel c r} (yy e v) := by
      rw [map_mul]
